summary: Bugfix + capability regeneration of clinical-source-excerpts-2026.09.21. scripts/extract_prepared_definitions.py: (1) ABBREV_HEADING guard (already applied, uncommitted, by a prior agent) excludes a document's 'Список сокращений'/'Сокращения' heading from the early-chunk lead-paragraph heuristic, so it is never mislabeled as one acronym's own definition; (2) new ABBREV_SECTION_HEADING branch (added in this pass) captures that same heading's block verbatim under its own coverage='abbreviation-section', with no chunk-position or source-type restriction, because the previously-committed clinical-glossary-and-abbreviations-2026.09.28.json abbreviation splitter (tools/ingest/src/localmed_ingest/clinical_definition_sections.py) depends on exactly this raw text and would otherwise have lost all but 1 of its 597 input sections once the mislabeled records were removed. Regenerated offline (no network) from the same 744 pinned per-document SQLite packs at output/release-0.6.33/packages/, verified byte-identical by sha256 to the previously committed extraction's recorded databaseSha256 for every file.
downstreamNote: The already-committed content/definition-drafts/clinical-glossary-and-abbreviations-2026.09.28.json (5ccbed57) is a static artifact and remains valid as-is; its 541 definition-section-derived clinical definitions are drawn from records verified byte-identical before and after this regeneration. Its 597-section/6418-abbreviation KR abbreviation route was built from the (then buggy) explicit-definition records with a 'Список сокращений' heading; if that splitter is re-run against the regenerated drafts it will now see 931 abbreviation-section records (596 of the old ones, now correctly coverage-typed, plus 335 more that the old chunk_order<3 restriction silently dropped) instead of the old 597.
